actual_operator_steps_remaining: Step 1: Provide or approve an inbound secure TLS tunnel / reverse proxy URL pointing to the local COSM-Relay HTTP Gateway (e.g. 127.0.0.1:18888).
Step 2: Copy the 5-tool MCP definition from SITE_PROMPT.txt into ChatGPT @Sites to build the 'COSM-Relay-Bridge' site.
Step 3: In the Site settings, set the backend server URL to the approved HTTPS tunnel URL and configure the Bearer Authorization header.
Step 4: Publish the site as a Personal Plugin, activate it in the ChatGPT Plus Supervisor session, and invoke status.
